title: Pumpkin & Ghost Night Workshop with Raku Firing
bring: No pieces required for this workshop; pieces are created during the event
cost_text: $85 for workshop; optional raku firing available for $10 per piece
summary: A beginner-friendly two-hour workshop to create clay pumpkins and ghosts, with optional raku firing available on-site for $10 per piece. No prior experience needed.
how_to_join: Sign up on the website or through the workshop listing
source_quote: PUMPKIN & GHOST NIGHT! Friday, October 23, 6-8 PM, No Experience, 16+ Starts Oct 23 $85
evidence_sentence: The workshop offers optional raku firing for created pieces at $10 per piece including glazing and firing.
evidence_quote: Raku firing will be available at our next Raku event for $10 per piece, including glazing, firing, and time to relax and enjoy the experience with us.
pay_text: $85 workshop fee; optional $10 per piece for raku firing
